item.text:
Yes. Use:

```http
DELETE https://api.mistral.ai/v1/agents/{agent_id}
```

Example:

```bash
curl https://api.mistral.ai/v1/agents/{agent_id} \
  -X DELETE \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_API_KEY"
```

The SDK equivalent is `mistral.beta.agents.delete(agent_id="<id>")`. See Mistral’s [Agents API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/beta/agents).
